description: Read-only JSON-RPC pass-through for Solana mainnet. Allowed methods: getAccountInfo, getBalance, getTransaction, getSignaturesForAddress (limit <= 100), getTokenAccountsByOwner, getTokenSupply, getSlot, getBlockTime, getLatestBlockhash, getMultipleAccounts (<= 20). Write methods and getProgramAccounts refused. Price: $0.001 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

method.description: Solana JSON-RPC read method (e.g. getSlot, getBalance)

name: rpc_solana
title: Rpc Solana
